name: Todo Toolkit
summary: A comprehensive software engineering toolkit with skills, agents, and hooks for Claude Code
description:
Todo Toolkit provides a complete set of tools for modern software development. It includes specialized skills for different domains (backend, frontend, architecture, business analysis), intelligent agents for code review and testing, and safety hooks to prevent accidental mistakes.

**Features:**
- 7 specialized skills covering backend, frontend, architecture, and operations
- 3 intelligent agents for testing, code review, and API research
- 2 safety hooks to protect your codebase
- Production-ready code standards enforcement
- Comprehensive documentation and best practices
